messages:
Ryan (sales): FYI OmniHealth POC starts Monday. They want a 2-day smoke + throughput validation. Need reserved GPU preheat, autoscale policy, and security questionnaire answers.
Alex (solutions): Whats their request shape? tokens per response, sync vs async, embedding usage?
Ryan (sales): Mostly chat/generation. Bursts up to ~250 qps for a few mins, steady ~60 qps. Median output ~100 tokens, prompt ~40. Minimal embeddings.
Alex (solutions): Back-of-envelope: redwood-14b-v1 ~0.7	1.0s p50 on 48GB A10G equiv for 100 tokens. Recommend reserved 6 GPUs + autoscale to 10 for spikes (with batching).
Jen (infra): Proposed autoscale policy: min_reserved: 6, scale_step: 1 GPU / 30s, max_reserved: 12, scale triggers: queued_requests and p95_latency.
Sachin (sre): Can we use burst credit pool to avoid cold starts for short spikes (e.g., <120s)? Cheaper than immediate scale.
Alex (solutions): Plan: reserved pool 6, burst credits for +4 GPUs for up to 3m, autoscale if >3m. Cost-efficient and keeps SLOs.
Ryan (sales): Customer asked about pricing if they use quantized models.
Alex (solutions): redwood-14b-quant (q8) gives ~+30% throughput; we usually offer a 15% unit-price discount on reserved SKUs for committed quant variants. Will add to quote.
Priya (security): On questionnaire: Dedicated supports VPC peering or private deployment, KMS/customer-managed keys, SOC2 Type II, audit logs (add-on). Need the PDF link to fill details.
Ryan (sales): Heres the Q: https://omnichealth.example.com/sec-qna.pdf They also asked about admin console IP allowlist.
Priya (security): We support IP allowlist and stricter session timeouts. Ill draft the response and share EOD tomorrow.
Jen (infra): Preheat steps to warm KV cache before canary: 1) seed top prompts; 2) run synthetic warmer at 10 qps for 10m; 3) verify kv_cache_hit_rate >60%. Snippet below.
Jen (infra): ```
# preheat-runbook (snippet)
- Step 0: deploy canary variant (quant if agreed) to reserved pool
- Step 1: run warm generator over top-50 prompts at 10 qps for 10m
- Step 2: monitor kv_cache_hit_rate, p50/p95 latency
- Step 3: if hit_rate < 50% -> increase seed set; if p95 > target -> add 1 GPU
```
Sachin (sre): OpsBot: please schedule smoke test Monday 09:00 PT (canary + 2-day load validation).
OpsBot: Scheduled smoke_test_omnichealth for 2026-04-06T16:00:00Z. Canary will use reserved pool 6 + burst credits. Report will be posted here. :robot_face:
Alex (solutions): Deliverables i'll drop: 1-pager sizing rationale, preheat runbook, pricing delta table, and a filled security checklist draft. Will post by EOD.
Ryan (sales): Can someone paste the exact autoscale JSON for the client ops team?
Jen (infra): Quick JSON snippet for handoff:
Jen (infra): ```
{"autoscale": {"min_reserved": 6, "max_reserved": 12, "scale_step_secs": 30, "burst_credit_threshold_secs": 180, "metrics": ["queued_requests", "p95_latency"]}}
```
Sachin (sre): Ill attach an eviction/spot fallback tolerance table and SLA notes to the deliverable.
Alex (solutions): Risk note: if they insist on 100% quantized variants we may need +2 GPUs to hit same latency SLO due to kernel shapes. Will call out in the quote.
Ryan (sales): Great. Priya once your security doc is ready ping me and ill loop legal. :thumbsup:
Priya (security): Will do.
Ryan (sales): Thanks team.
